solarquarry.battery.status: Battery: %s / %s  |  in %s E/t, out %s E/t  |  limit %s E/t
tooltip.solarquarry.quarry: Mines a 16x16 area layer by layer. Needs energy.
tooltip.solarquarry.solar_panel_basic: Up to 8 E/t in full sun. Nothing at night; rain cuts output to 40%.
tooltip.solarquarry.solar_panel_advanced: Up to 40 E/t in full sun. Nothing at night; rain cuts output to 60%.
tooltip.solarquarry.solar_panel_elite: Up to 180 E/t in full sun, about 22 E/t at night. Rain only cuts output to 80%.
tooltip.solarquarry.energy_cable: Connects panels, batteries, quarries and terminals. Right-click for a network summary.
tooltip.solarquarry.item_pipe: Carries items to chests and other inventories
tooltip.solarquarry.filter_pipe: Right-click to set allowed or blocked items, item tags and route priority.
tooltip.solarquarry.wrench: Use on a Solar Quarry block to pick it up. Quarries and batteries keep everything.
tooltip.solarquarry.upgrade.void: Deletes items listed in the quarry's void filter
tooltip.solarquarry.upgrade.stack: Stacks up to %s in one upgrade slot
gui.solarquarry.filter_help_whitelist: Allow: only listed items (templates or tags) pass. Listed items prefer this route over unfiltered ones.
gui.solarquarry.filter_help_blacklist: Block: listed items can't pass. Everything else passes.
solarquarry.status.idle.hint: Set the mode and area under Config, then press Start.
solarquarry.status.scanning.hint: Prospecting the area for ores; mining starts as soon as one is found.
solarquarry.status.paused.hint: Paused by you. Press Resume to continue where it stopped.
solarquarry.status.waiting_for_power.hin: Needs %s E per block. Connect solar panels or a charged battery with energy cables.
solarquarry.status.output_blocked.hint: Buffer is full. Attach an item pipe or chest, or take items out.
solarquarry.status.waiting_for_chunk.hin: The next block is in an unloaded chunk. Stay nearby, or install a Chunk Loader Upgrade.
solarquarry.status.complete.hint: Work volume finished. Press Start to run it again, or change the area under Config.
solarquarry.mode.strip_mine.desc: Mines the whole area layer by layer from the quarry's level down to the target depth.
solarquarry.mode.tunnel_bore.desc: Bores a tunnel (width x height) straight back from the quarry, starting at its level. Length can reach 4x the area limit.
solarquarry.mode.area_clear.desc: Clears the area from the quarry's level upward to the set height, top layer first. Good for flattening terrain.
solarquarry.mode.ore_priority.desc: Scans the strip-mine volume and mines ores first (c:ores, or only the Ore list if it has entries), then the rest unless Ores Only is on.
gui.solarquarry.start.tooltip: Start mining. If the job is complete, the scan restarts from the top.
gui.solarquarry.pause.tooltip: Stop after the current block. Progress is kept.
gui.solarquarry.resume.tooltip: Continue from where it was paused.
gui.solarquarry.mode_button.tooltip: Click to change mode (Shift: previous). Changing the mode restarts the scan.
gui.solarquarry.ores_only.tooltip: On: stop after every ore has been mined and leave the rest. Off: then strip mine everything else.
gui.solarquarry.restart.tooltip: Restart the scan from the first cell. Already mined cells are skipped quickly.
gui.solarquarry.list.void.tooltip: Void list: drops matching these items are deleted, but only while a Void Upgrade is installed. Click a slot with an item to set it, with an empty hand to clear it.
gui.solarquarry.list.skip.tooltip: Skip list: blocks matching these items are never mined, in every mode.
gui.solarquarry.list.ores.tooltip: Ore list: Ore Priority mines only these blocks first. Empty = every block tagged c:ores.
gui.solarquarry.hint.no_output: No pipe or chest attached: the buffer will fill and mining will stop.
gui.solarquarry.energy.flow: Last second: in %s E/t, used %s E/t
gui.solarquarry.upgrades.speed: Speed: up to %s blocks/min at full power
gui.solarquarry.upgrades.cost: Cost: %s E per stone block (about %s E/t running)
gui.solarquarry.upgrades.void: Void: deletes items on the Void list
gui.solarquarry.upgrades.rules: One upgrade type per slot. Fortune and Silk Touch can't be combined.
solarquarry.solar.no_sky: Solar: 0 E/t  |  blocked: needs open sky directly above
solarquarry.network.summary: Energy network: %s cables, %s panels making %s E/t, %s batteries holding %s / %s, %s machines
gui.solarquarry.match.tooltip: Item only: any item of the same type matches. Exact: data such as enchantments and names must match too.
gui.solarquarry.priority.tooltip: Items prefer routes through higher-priority filters (-5 to +5). When those destinations are full, they overflow to lower ones. Plain pipes count as 0.
gui.solarquarry.tags: Item tags (any match counts as listed)
gui.solarquarry.tag.tooltip: An item tag such as c:ores, c:raw_materials or minecraft:logs. Items in the tag count as listed.
tooltip.solarquarry.remote_terminal: Monitors and controls the quarries on its energy-cable network.
tooltip.solarquarry.prospector.chunk: Use: exact ore count in your chunk, from your feet down.
tooltip.solarquarry.prospector.quarry: Use on a quarry: exact count of the ores left in its work volume (takes a moment).
tooltip.solarquarry.card.usage: Sneak + use on a quarry or filter pipe to copy. Use to apply. Sneak + use in the air to clear.
solarquarry.card.empty: This card is empty. Sneak + use on a machine to copy its settings first.
solarquarry.card.wrong_kind: This card holds settings for a different kind of machine.
solarquarry.card.too_new: This card was written by a newer version of Solar Quarry (format %s) and can't be applied.
solarquarry.card.applied_quarry: Applied preset: %s, %s x %s. Items, energy and upgrades were not touched.
solarquarry.prospector.chunk: Prospector: chunk %s, %s, from Y %s down to Y %s (exact count):
solarquarry.terminal.gone: That quarry is no longer connected to this terminal.
gui.solarquarry.terminal.mode.tooltip: Switch to the next mining mode. This restarts the scan.
gui.solarquarry.terminal.deeper.tooltip: Lower the target depth by 10 blocks.
gui.solarquarry.terminal.shallower.toolt: Raise the target depth by 10 blocks.
gui.solarquarry.terminal.empty: No quarries on this network. Connect quarries to the terminal with energy cables.
gui.solarquarry.terminal.select: Select a quarry on the left.
gui.solarquarry.terminal.low_space: Connected storage is almost full (under 10% free slots).
gui.solarquarry.terminal.locked: Read only: this quarry belongs to %s.
tooltip.solarquarry.upgrade.chunk_loader: Keeps the quarry's 3×3 chunks and the chunk it mines loaded while it runs
Chunk loading is disabled on this server
gui.solarquarry.upgrades.chunk_loader.id: Chunk loading: off (only while running and powered)
gui.solarquarry.upgrades.chunk_loader.di: Chunk loading: disabled on this server
solarquarry.prospector.scanning: Scanning %s blocks of the quarry's remaining volume…
solarquarry.prospector.quarry_exact: Ores left in quarry at %s, %s, %s (%s blocks scanned):
solarquarry.prospector.unloaded: %s blocks were in unloaded chunks and not counted
solarquarry.prospector.gone: The quarry was removed before the scan finished
tooltip.solarquarry.solar_multiplier: This server multiplies solar output by %s
tooltip.solarquarry.reinforced_pipe: Twice as fast as a basic pipe; moves 32 items at a time, holds 12 stacks.
tooltip.solarquarry.advanced_pipe: Five times as fast as a basic pipe; moves 64 items at a time, holds 16 stacks.
tooltip.solarquarry.sorting_terminal: Place against a pipe network to choose which chest gets which items.
gui.solarquarry.sorting.mode.allow.toolt: Receives only the items and tags listed below. Listed destinations are filled first.
gui.solarquarry.sorting.mode.block.toolt: Receives everything except the items and tags listed below, after the "only listed" destinations.
gui.solarquarry.sorting.mode.fallback.to: Receives whatever no other destination takes, including overflow when they are full.
gui.solarquarry.sorting.priority.tooltip: Among destinations of the same kind, higher priority fills first.
gui.solarquarry.sorting.empty: No chests on this pipe network. Connect inventories to the pipes.
gui.solarquarry.sorting.warn_empty_allow: Nothing listed yet: put template items in the grid or type tags, or this chest receives nothing.
gui.solarquarry.sorting.note_block_all: Nothing excluded: this chest accepts everything after the listed destinations.
gui.solarquarry.sorting.no_fallback: No fallback chest: items no destination takes stay in the machine.
gui.solarquarry.xp.tooltip: Experience from mined ores: %s points. Click to collect.
gui.solarquarry.torches.tooltip: Torches: the quarry lights the pit walls every 4 layers (tunnels every 4 blocks).
tooltip.solarquarry.crate_basic: 54 slots (a double chest). Pick it up full with the wrench.
tooltip.solarquarry.crate_reinforced: 108 slots on 2 pages. Pick it up full with the wrench.
tooltip.solarquarry.crate_advanced: 162 slots on 3 pages. Pick it up full with the wrench.
tooltip.solarquarry.fluid_pipe: Carries liquid from a quarry's Liquid Remover to Liquid Tanks.
tooltip.solarquarry.liquid_tank: Holds 64 buckets of one liquid. Empty it with buckets.
tooltip.solarquarry.upgrade.liquid_remov: Adds a pump arm that drains liquid ahead of the drill. Pipe it to a Liquid Tank with fluid pipes; with a Void Upgrade the liquid is deleted.
gui.solarquarry.upgrades.liquid.no_pipe: Connect a fluid pipe to a Liquid Tank, or the pump stops when full
tooltip.solarquarry.super_smelter: Electric furnace with three lanes, 4x furnace speed. 16 E/t per working lane, nothing while idle.
gui.solarquarry.smelter.cost: %s E/t per working lane (%s E per item)
gui.solarquarry.smelter.speed: %sx furnace speed; idle lanes draw nothing
tooltip.solarquarry.upgrade.auto_smelter: Smelts mined ores and raw metals before they reach the buffer (furnace recipes). Stone, sand and the rest come out as mined.
+%s E per item smelted (less with Efficiency)
Fortune: every extra raw ore becomes an extra ingot. Silk Touch: ore blocks smelt to one ingot each.
Void-listed items are deleted first and never smelted. Smelting experience is stored with the mining experience.
gui.solarquarry.upgrades.auto_smelter: Auto-Smelter: ores and raw metals are smelted
tooltip.solarquarry.fabrication_bench: Workbench with a catalogue of every Solar Quarry recipe. Pick an item, see what it needs, craft it straight from your inventory.
gui.solarquarry.bench.craft_max.tooltip: Crafts as many as your ingredients allow (up to 64)
solarquarry.trader.welcome: [Solar Quarry Trader] Welcome, %s! I run the Solar Quarry supply shop near the world spawn.
solarquarry.trader.kit: [Solar Quarry Trader] Here is a starter kit: parts for your first quarry, solar panels, cable, pipes, a wrench and a Fabrication Bench. Craft the quarry at the bench.
solarquarry.trader.shop: [Solar Quarry Trader] Visit me at %s, %s, %s to buy parts and sell what your quarry digs up.
solarquarry.trader.parcel: Your inventory is full: %s starter kit items will be delivered as soon as there is room.
solarquarry.trader.parcel_done: The rest of your starter kit has been delivered.
